# Pishdad
> The first Persian-first, self-hosted content management system. Free and MIT-licensed,
> built for right-to-left Persian, and verified before any plugin code runs.

Pishdad (پیشداد) is a plugin-based CMS for building and managing websites. It is named
after the Pishdadians, the first dynasty of the Shahnameh.

## Stack
- Backend: Laravel 11 (API-only), PHP 8.2+
- Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- Data: PostgreSQL 14+ with fa-IR collation, Redis, MinIO (S3-compatible)
- API: OpenAPI 3.1, 135 endpoints, client types generated into the frontend
- Tests: PHPUnit, 489 tests

## What makes it different
- Persian and RTL from the first commit: CSS logical properties, Jalali dates, a locally
  served Persian typeface, and no external CDN.
- Plugins are declarative and signed. A package declares permissions, header/footer
  widgets and page types through a manifest, and is signed with Ed25519. The trust store
  verifies the signature before any plugin code loads, and a package carrying an embedded
  credential is rejected at install.
- SEO tooling is in the core, not an add-on: sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt and an
  on-site search endpoint.

## Licensing and hosting
Free and MIT-licensed, with no premium edition, no seat count and no telemetry.
Self-hosted: it runs on a server you control, and your data stays there.
